title: Don't Stop Moving
description: Minecraft but if you stand still you take damage. !Warning Very Buggy!
body:
!This mod was made very quickly with limited testing expect bugs!
If you stop moving, you will take damage.
By default, standing still deals 1 heart (2 damage) per hit, but this can be customized.
________________________________________________________________________________________________

# Commands

### /startGame    
Starts the minigame.

### /stopGame     
Stops the minigame.

### /setDamage <float>     
Sets the amount of damage dealt while standing still.

### /getDamage     
Displays the current damage value applied while standing still.
